strings.obs.karsk.stove.text: Old sleepers in a tar drum. Burns badly, warms all the same – the men talk about the night shift, not about the wagons.
strings.obs.karsk.poster.text: New housing blocks by the autumn, the poster promises. The waiting list beside it has been extended in pencil.
strings.obs.karsk.family.text: Three generations, four bundles, one wooden crate. They wait the way people wait here: without asking.
strings.doc.karsk.signal_board.title: Practice box – unpowered training model
strings.doc.karsk.seal.alt: Lead seal on the wagon door: station stamp struck twice, beneath it, scraped off, “C-17”. Scratched beside it: square, circle, triangle.
strings.doc.karsk.timetable.alt: Working timetable: three rebooked wagon lines with no destination station, marked in the margin with square, circle and triangle – from top to bottom.
strings.doc.karsk.ledger.alt: Freight ledger: a new line for wagon 24-311 with a red “C-17” stamp. The consignee has been blacked out.
strings.doc.karsk.signal_board.alt: Unpowered practice box with three empty card slots, a dead indicator lamp and a sample diagram. Not part of a real signalling system.
